thread:
Marta Ruiz: Hey folks — PR #52740 is ready for review: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/infra/pull/52740. Small change to our rate-limiter defaults (increase burst to 200 -> 500) and a configmap tweak. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before I merge. Hoping to ship in the 8am UTC merge window tomorrow.
Samir Patel: Quick q — is this behind a feature flag or will it affect all traffic immediately?
Marta Ruiz: Not behind a flag, it's a default fallback for services that don't set custom limits. We can gate it but that'll need a separate flag + rollout.
Jose Lin: Runtime concern — increasing burst might make KV cache pressure worse. Do we have perf numbers? Can we run a short load test against staging? :thinking_face:
Marta Ruiz: Yep — I ran a quick local sim, latency looks fine for 99p but I'll upload perf logs here in a sec. For now the change is only in the configmap: 
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  rate_limiter.burst: "500"
  rate_limiter.qps: "100"
```
Samir Patel: CI looks green :white_check_mark: (platform-ci-bot). Can we add a canary plan? 10% for 4h, then 50%?
Marta Ruiz: Sounds good. Canary plan: 10% traffic for 4h, monitor latency and error rate; if no regressions, move to 50% for 2h then full. I'll add rollout steps to the PR description.
Helen Cho: Security quick check — any new deps or auth changes? Also need a short threat-note for the change (rate-limiter adjustments can affect DoS surface). Please add a 2-line rationale in the PR and tag me.
Marta Ruiz: No new deps. Added threat note and quick checklist in PR. @Helen Cho and @Jose Lin — can you both LGTMs when you have a chance? I plan to merge in the 8am UTC window unless someone flags something.
Jose Lin: I'll run a 30m perf run in staging tomorrow morning and ping back. If results are good I'll +1. :thumbsup:
platform-ci-bot: PR #52740 — all checks passed (unit, integration, perf smoke) — https://ci.redwood.com/build/113452
Samir Patel: I'm happy to review the rollout doc and sign off on platform side. Will do before merge window.
Marta Ruiz: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. I'll queue the canary and update the PR with the staging test link once Jose posts results.
